Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SDAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is B.Sc. (Agri.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 12th October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the SDAU office in Sardarkrushinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof and educational certificates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of the organization?
faq.answer: The official website of the organization is www.sdau.edu.in.
